items: 🚀【Octa-Core Power and Android 15】Like a race car engine, our tablet is equipped with an advanced A523 octa-core processor (up to 2.0GHz). Running Android 15 OS, this electronics tablet delivers lag-free multitasking for work apps, games, and mobile browsing. Imagine switching between spreadsheets and videos as smoothly as changing lanes on the highway.

💾 【Massive Storage & Dual Cameras】Our tablet with keyboard boasts 24GB physical RAM (4GB + 20GB Smart RAM) and 128GB ROM, expandable via TF card up to 1TB (TF card not included). This outperforms standard 10-inch Android tablets in its class. Equipped with a 5MP front camera and an 8MP rear camera featuring autofocus and flash, it handles video calls and everyday photography with ease.

🎬 【Widevine L1 Certified & HD Display】This 10.1-inch 800x1280 low-blue-light HD screen tablet is like a window to a vibrant world. Widevine L1 certification lets you enjoy true HD content on Netflix and Disney+, turning your tablet into a portable cinema. Imagine watching your favorite shows with colors so vivid, it feels like the characters are right beside you.

📶 【Faster Connectivity and Long-Lasting Durability】This octa-core tablet features the latest WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4, connecting up to 3 times faster than standard tablets. Our long-lasting battery paired with our low-power octa-core processor delivers up to 6 hours of continuous video playback on a single charge, with support for Type-C fast charging.From morning coffee to late-night movies, it's a reliable companion that keeps pace with your busy day.

🎁【All-in-One Productivity & Entertainment】The Higrace 2-in-1 Tablet Bundle transforms you into a complete workstation with this ultimate set! Includes a Bluetooth keyboard, mouse, protective case, stylus and 3.5mm headphones—everything you need is included. This versatile kit combines convenience (weighing approximately 520g), powerful functionality, and modern style, making it an ideal gift for colleagues, friends, family, and business professionals.
